additional_info.subject: ID0408069-DC/SI-D/AE [MP /R8 170002526] Charging Interruption CRM:00251000473
additional_info.body:
Dear Basheer Thangal,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Reetesh
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R8 170002526
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
wRsIIZ
Problem Description
:
Charging Interruption due to authentication
Answer : The tag Presented by user was Blocked by OCPP backend
During the log analysis, we foud that the Tag presented by user at 07:05 UTC was blocked at OCPP backend, hence the charging session was not successful.
Please see below
StartTransaction (f65277d5-255b-41fa-aad5-794fc491cadb) - {"connectorId":2,"idTag":"04510F7A240289","meterStart":0,"timestamp":"2025-02-20T07:07:25.730Z"}
:
2025-02-20T07:07:25.924658+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/518ae484caba[733]: OCPP: Received result: StartTransaction (f65277d5-255b-41fa-aad5-794fc491cadb) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Blocked","parentIdTag":"U0001684"},"transactionId":0}
Detailed information about the session is available in the attached log file. We don't see any issue with the charger.
Also, I would like to highlight that the charger is running on FW v3.2.8 and it is recommended updating to v6.0.3.
As your query has been answered, shall I proceed to close the case.
For future reference, your case number is
0408069
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
